patterns.name: Hammer / hanging man
patterns.definition: small body in the upper part of the range, lower shadow >=2x body, little/no upper shadow
patterns.confirmation: hanging man needs a lower next open or black lower close
patterns.context: hammer after a downtrend, hanging man after an uptrend
patterns.strengtheners: smaller body, longer shadow; white hammer / black hanging man slightly stronger
patterns.caveat: No statistics in the source; hand-picked 1989-90 charts; definitions chosen to favour the pattern.
patterns.repo_status: candle features built (c_*) for the basic shapes

patterns.name: Shooting star / inverted hammer
patterns.definition: small body at the low end, long upper shadow
patterns.confirmation: inverted hammer needs a higher next open / white bar
patterns.context: star after uptrend; inverted hammer after downtrend
patterns.strengtheners: body gaps away from prior body; failure at resistance
patterns.caveat: No statistics in the source; hand-picked 1989-90 charts; definitions chosen to favour the pattern.

patterns.name: Windows (range gaps)
patterns.definition: gap between prior bar's extreme and this bar's extreme; moves go in the direction of the window
patterns.confirmation: closing the window then continued pressure voids it
patterns.context: corrections return to the window; windows become support/resistance
patterns.strengtheners: from congestion or new highs; three windows -> turn; 8-10 consecutive new highs -> correction
patterns.caveat: No statistics in the source; hand-picked 1989-90 charts; definitions chosen to favour the pattern.

patterns.name: Broadening bottom
patterns.definition: downtrend into a megaphone: >=2 minor highs and >=2 minor lows, top line up, bottom line down
patterns.book_trade_rule: buy the turn at the lower line, stop below the minor low; partial decline -> long
patterns.caveat: small sample; essentially bearish

patterns.name: Bump-and-run reversal bottom
patterns.definition: down-sloping lead-in trendline (30-45 deg), rounded base, close above the trendline
patterns.book_trade_rule: buy confirmation; stop below prior support; sell half at old high
patterns.caveat: 14% of cases >90%

patterns.name: Bump-and-run reversal top
patterns.definition: rising trendline, lead-in >=1 month, bump >=2x lead-in height, close below trendline
patterns.book_trade_rule: sell near the bump using warning/sell lines
patterns.caveat: largest declines near yearly lows

patterns.name: Cup with handle
patterns.definition: U-shaped cup after >=30% rise, small handle, break above right lip
patterns.book_trade_rule: buy after throwback to the lip; stop below handle
patterns.caveat: strict O'Neil rules did worse (38% failure)

patterns.name: Dead-cat bounce
patterns.definition: gap-down collapse on ~15-20x volume, bounce, then lower lows
patterns.book_trade_rule: sell into the bounce; short after rounding over
patterns.caveat: 81% undercut the event low

patterns.name: Diamond top/bottom

patterns.name: Double bottom
patterns.definition: downtrend; two lows within 4% (classic 3%), >=10 days apart, >=10% rise between (classic 20%); second low must not undercut the first
patterns.confirmation: close above the highest high between the lows (confirmation point)
patterns.book_trade_rule: buy after the throwback; sell near target

book_stats.failure_pct: 3% among confirmed; 64% of lookalikes never confirmed

patterns.caveat: closer lows did better; strongest selection-bias example

patterns.name: Double top
patterns.definition: uptrend; two highs within 3%, decline between >=10% (classic 20%), peaks few weeks to a year apart
patterns.confirmation: close below the lowest low between the peaks
patterns.book_trade_rule: do not trade before confirmation; sell after second top; short after pullback
